title: dev-11: CooklangParser public facade
description: Implement the public CooklangParser struct in CooklangParser.swift. Exposes init(extensions:converter:), static .canonical and .extended instances, parse(_:) -> Recipe, and parseMetadata(_:) -> Metadata. Delegates to the internal document-structure parser. All public API types must be exported from CookbookCore.
acceptance_criteria: public struct CooklangParser is declared with init(extensions:converter:), static canonical, static extended, func parse(_:) throws -> Recipe, func parseMetadata(_:) throws -> Metadata.
CooklangParser.canonical.parse("") returns a Recipe with empty sections, ingredients, cookware, timers, and empty metadata.allEntries.
Parsing the same input twice returns equal Recipe values (==).
The parser does not perform I/O or mutate the input string.
